about_005: We’re building Provenix to make the relationships and logic behind data visible, understandable, and easier to share.
about_009: SQL contains a wealth of knowledge: where data originates, how it changes, and what goes into a metric. Too often, that knowledge stays scattered across files and inside people’s heads.
about_010: When a new analyst joins, a calculation changes, or a number looks wrong, teams have to reconstruct that story. We believe the code itself should be the starting point for understanding it.
about_011: Provenix turns SQL into a connected view of sources, transformations, and outputs. Our focus is practical: help the people working with data see the logic behind it.
about_015: Extract relationships and formulas from SQL structure. Keep the explanation connected to the code behind it.
about_017: Bring detailed technical context into a visual experience that supports investigation and conversation.
about_019: Focus on the everyday work of understanding pipelines, reviewing calculations, and onboarding to unfamiliar data.
about_023: Provenix is in active development. Today, our work centers on SQL analysis, column-level lineage, formula inspection, and visual exploration.
about_024: Our longer-term ambition is to connect that technical foundation to richer business context and documentation. We’re building toward that vision thoughtfully, and welcome conversations with teams facing these challenges.
